title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
description: Elizabeth Bennet has judged Mr Darcy, and Mr Darcy has judged the Bennets. Austen spends four hundred pages proving both of them wrong, one perfectly balanced sentence at a time.
snippet: It is a truth universally acknowledged, that a single man in possession of a good fortune, must be in want of a wife.
